Name: Uzzah, Son of Abinadab
Summary: Uzzah, son of Abinadab, drove the new cart carrying the ark to Jerusalem. When the oxen stumbled at Nachon's threshingfloor, he took hold of the ark to steady it, and God struck him dead there for his error.
KeyStory: Uzzah steadied the ark with his hand — and died for touching what only priests might carry.
RelatedPeople: Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim; Ahio, Son of Abinadab; King David
LifeLesson: Good intentions do not make holy things safe to handle carelessly.
